name: GhostLink
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostLink. Same navigation contract plus variant and tone. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes link styles to this instance.

props.name: as
props.description: Host element or router component forwarded to the unstyled GhostLink.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables navigation on the inner host.

props.name: external
props.description: Shows the external indicator for same-tab outbound links.

props.name: newTabLabel
props.description: Visually hidden hint when target is _blank.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual presentation mode. Use button for GhostButton-styled navigation links.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment. Defaults to inline for link appearance and solid for button appearance.

props.name: tone
props.description: Color intent. Danger applies when appearance is button. The default omits data-tone.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size when appearance is button. The default omits data-size.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Link text forwarded to the unstyled GhostLink.

slots.name: externalIndicator
slots.description: Optional external icon content inside data-part=external-icon.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The inner navigable host after mount.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the inner host when enabled.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The navigable host inside the display:contents themed scope.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-space-gap-xs
cssProperties.description: Gap between text and icon; underline offset.

keyboard.Tab: Enabled links participate in tab order.
